subject: Web Development
title: Cumulative Layout Shift
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Cumulative Layout Shift.

hook.text: You're about to tap a button and suddenly the page jumps. An ad loaded above it.

buildup.text: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) measures how much page content moves unexpectedly during load.

discovery.text: A good CLS score is under 0.1. Anything higher means elements are shifting around too much.

twist.text: Images without width and height attributes are the number one cause of layout shift worldwide.

climax.text: CLS turned a user annoyance into a measurable metric that affects search rankings.

punchline.text: Set your dimensions or watch your content dance.
